notes: Title and ordering: 2 km reach; Recommended Operating Conditions lists Operating Distance min 2 m, max 2000 m. Receiver Sensitivity (OMAouter) min is -3.7 dBm for TECQ < 0.9 dB; for 0.9 dB ≤ TECQ ≤ SECQ min is – 4.6 + TECQ dBm. Stressed Receiver Sensitivity (OMAouter) is -1.2 dBm with SECQ 3.4 dB and OMAouter of each aggressor lane 0.8 dBm. Sensitivity measured at BER = 6.4x10-5 per Note 1. Signaling rate optical 113.4375±50 ppm GBd per lane; electrical module TP1/TP4 106.25±50 ppm GBd. Maximum Power Dissipation 30 W; Low Power Mode max 2 W. Average launch power each lane min (-2.2 dBm) noted as informative per Note 2. Transmitter reflectance defined looking into the transmitter per Note 3. Connector stated as LC/UPC in title and LC/PC in Features.
